text: Implemented exact executable spectral rewrites for all declared quadratic families, objective-vs-denominator placement, multiset disagreement, and verified null-space hard equality. Requested/lowered programs, bound rewrite proofs, functional frames, residual certificates, and attained global-spectral guarantees now round-trip through IR. Dense objective/equality oracles, matrix-free preservation, semantic distinction tests, and full multivar plus multivar-IR suites pass on JVM and Scala.js.
